The equation is conceptually correct but could confuse implementers who expect it to mirror the explicit two-step decomposition described on lines 64-65. A clarifying note that line 63 is the top-level mass balance and lines 64-65 are the implementation form would help.

Minor: The maintenance action table (line 148) references `RemoveShrimp { count }` as an export action, but this action currently only decrements a population count (not biomass). ROUTING.md should note that until shrimp carry explicit per-individual biomass, the export accounting is approximate—consistent with the microfauna index-based caveat.
